tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List Dribba's services with a one-line summary and URL.

limit.description: Maximum number of services to return. Omit for all of them.

tools.name: estimate_project
tools.description: Ballpark budget and range for an app/product, mirroring dribba.com's public calculator. Minimum project budget is €30,000.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List Dribba's case studies (slug, title, industry).

industry.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the industry, e.g. "fintech". Omit for all industries.

limit.description: Maximum number of case studies to return.

tools.name: company_facts
tools.description: Structured facts about Dribba: positioning, offices, team, distinctions, clients.

fields.description: Subset of fact keys to return (e.g. ["offices","distinctions"]). Omit for every fact.

tools.name: submit_contact_request
tools.description: Submit a real project inquiry to Dribba on behalf of the user. This sends an email and creates a lead — ONLY call it after the user has explicitly confirmed the exact name, email and message to be sent. Dribba replies within 1h. Rate-limited per client.

name.description: Full name of the person making the inquiry.

email.description: Email address Dribba should reply to.

message.description: The inquiry, confirmed by the user.
